seo_title: Cost of Living in Dubai 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Dubai per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A high standard of service, safety and zero income tax. Ideal for professionals earning $4,000+ and for entrepreneurs: steep rent and school fees are offset by the quality of life.
pros: A hub airport — convenient for flying around the world
A developed English-speaking environment, many Russian speakers in IT
Premium service in healthcare, schools and restaurants
cons: Very high cost of housing and schooling for children
Unbearable heat and humidity from May to September
Residency status depends on your employer or company
Cultural restrictions and a strict daily life
Alcohol — only in licensed venues and with a resident's certificate

best_places.name: JLT (Jumeirah Lake Towers)
best_places.description: The most convenient district for remote work — metro, restaurants and gyms nearby.

best_places.name: Dubai Marina
best_places.description: A pedestrian waterfront, premium rentals, restaurants and yachts — the main lifestyle district.

best_places.name: The Pavilion d3
best_places.description: A concept coworking in the Design District, home to the creative and startup crowd.

best_places.name: Time Out Market

visa_steps.title: Tourist visa
visa_steps.description: 60 days on arrival, free for Russian citizens. Can be extended by another 30 days.

visa_steps.title: Residence visa
visa_steps.description: Through an employer, a Free Zone company or a Golden Visa — grants an Emirates ID and access to banks.

visa_steps.title: Free Zone company
visa_steps.description: IFZA, RAKEZ, Dubai Internet City — from $5,000–10,000 a year. Includes a 2-year work visa.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Mashreq and Emirates NBD are the most welcoming. Opened after you receive your Emirates ID, in 2–4 weeks.

visa_steps.title: Rental via Ejari
visa_steps.description: All leases are registered in the state registry — required for bank accounts and visa renewal.

faq.question: Which visa suits a long-term relocation to Dubai?
faq.answer: A residence visa through a Free Zone company is the most popular route. Costs from $5,000 a year.

faq.question: What are the taxes in Dubai?
faq.answer: 0% income tax, 9% corporate tax on profits above $100,000. VAT is 5% on goods and services.

faq.question: How much does school cost in Dubai?
faq.answer: From $5,000 to $25,000 a year per child — depends on the curriculum (British, American, IB).

faq.question: Which banks work with Russians in Dubai?
faq.answer: Mashreq and Emirates NBD are welcoming. Accounts open after the Emirates ID, usually in 2–4 weeks.

faq.question: What about alcohol in Dubai?
faq.answer: Allowed in licensed restaurants and bars. To buy it in a shop you need a Liquor Licence as a resident.

faq.question: How much is health insurance in Dubai?
faq.answer: From $1,500 a year for a basic plan — mandatory for all residents.

reviews.text: Dubai is expensive, but for a family it's the best option in the East: schools, safety, the airport. It pays off with a salary higher than in Moscow.
The tax haven is real. But the first six months go into setting up the company, insurance and daily life.
